verified.concrete_places: Proper valuation subrings containing ℚ, all places including infinity; no arbitrary place carrier introduced.
verified.polynomial_membership_and_residue: Actual valuation-ring membership and actual residue homomorphism, with rational polynomial evaluation and no unnecessary transcendence/nonzero assumptions.
verified.integrality: IsCurveField provides finite-dimensionality of the full residue field over ℚ; integrality is a conclusion for every actual residue.
verified.nonzero_guard: The zero-residue positive-order helper requires y ≠ 0. The positivity proof separately obtains nonzero minpoly and nonzero evaluation from residue integrality and transcendence.
verified.ramification: Integer actual residue-minpoly order in the regular branch and negative integer order in the pole branch; ord(0)=0 is explicitly preserved. Positivity applies only to transcendental input, not constants.
verified.points: Every actual full-residue-field ring embedding into the fixed algebraic closure is retained.
verified.elementary_maps: Actual nonzero-determinant rational Möbius maps and positive-natural-degree rational polynomials; exact finite/infinite values and natural local indices. Total field division now explicit.
verified.composition: Head-first list action; local-index product evaluated along successive projective images; entire natural composite index is cast to ℤ in the final integer equality.
verified.proof_status: Five completed proof bodies, one direct sorry elementary child, one parent transitively dependent on that child. No inferred arbitrary laws or constant-function theorem.
verified.language: All three languages independently state their contexts. Simplified Chinese mathematical terms and Japanese mathematical terms are consistent; Möbius retains Latin spelling and diacritic. No terminology web lookup was performed.
verified.quotation: All english_mochizuki_quote null values remain unchanged; root will prepend its independently verified quotation.
